answer.rationale: Finance mandate of 18% spend cut is non-negotiable and incumbent has already refused reopening. With 14 days to contract expiration and no auto-renewal, deferral is not viable. Negotiation has been attempted (memory_c4 shows prior success but incumbent is now immovable). Renewing with incumbent guarantees cost escalation against mandate. Adding a second source alone doesn't address the primary cost gap. Switching to the low-cost vendor (memory_c2 demonstrates proven onboarding speed and invoicing accuracy, with sharp unit cost reduction) offers the only path to meet the 18% target while maintaining delivery continuity. The 94% assembly line utilization is tight but memory_c3 shows second-sourcing can mitigate allocation risk if needed in parallel next cycle. Verification of c2 (cost performance and onboarding) and c4 (negotiation limits) clarifies that switching is the least-risk option given hard constraints.
